water-treatment.title: Water treatment
water-treatment.tagline: Filtration, softening, iron-removal and reverse-osmosis units.

heating-unit.tagline: Block-modular heat substations — heating, DHW, combined.

control-systems.title: Control cabinets
control-systems.tagline: Five series — variable-frequency, fire-protection, smoke-control, sewage pumping and electric-actuator drives.

water-supply.title: Water supply
water-supply.tagline: Cold and domestic-hot-water pumping stations with pressure boosting for residential and commercial buildings.

firefighting.title: Fire protection
firefighting.tagline: Sprinkler, hydrant and combined fire-protection systems.

heating-cooling.title: Heating and cooling
heating-cooling.tagline: Heating-fluid and chilled-water circulation for building services circuits.
heating-cooling.image_alt: ANHEL — heating and cooling circulation station

pressure-boost.title: Pressure boosting
pressure-boost.tagline: Automatic pressure-boosting units for closed heating networks.

special.title: Special-purpose configuration
special.tagline: Container-based assemblies and GRP tanks — no permanent civil works required.

variable-frequency.title: Variable-frequency
variable-frequency.tagline: For pressure-boosting pumps in cold/hot water, heating and cooling systems. PID control, soft start, cascade control of up to 6 pumps.

electric-actuators.title: Electric-actuator drives
electric-actuators.tagline: Control of electric actuators on shut-off and control valves. Up to 5 valves, direct start, manual / automatic mode.

fire-suppression.title: Fire-protection systems
fire-suppression.tagline: Control of fire pumps in deluge and sprinkler systems, plus class-B foam fire suppression. ATS, supply priority, fire-alarm panel monitoring.

smoke-control.title: Smoke control and pressurisation
smoke-control.tagline: Smoke-control ventilation. Russian Federal Law 123-FZ fire certificate, IP54+, "Fire" indication, high-temperature endurance.

sewage-pumping.title: Sewage pumping
sewage-pumping.tagline: Control of drainage and sewage pumps, stormwater pumping. Float switches and level sensors, manual / automatic mode, up to 4 pumps.
